title: OpenVSCode Server
descript: OpenVSCode Server runs VS Code in your browser on the NAS: edit files, open a terminal, use git and install extensions from any device, with the workspace persisted in the application data folder. This package adds a random connection token so the editor is not reachable without the printed URL.
release_note: 1. First release: OpenVSCode Server 1.105.1 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Browser IDE with terminal, git and extensions; random connection token and workspace persisted in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The first start generates a connection token and prints the full URL (http://<NAS-IP>:<port>/?tkn=...) in the container log (docker logs openvscodedocker); the token is also stored in DockerAppData/openvscodedocker/workspace/.connection-token. The built-in terminal runs as uid 1000 on your NAS - keep it on the LAN and never expose it without a TLS reverse proxy. Back up the workspace folder before uninstalling with data removal.

wrapper_note:
the image runs VS Code without any connection token; this wrapper generates a random
token on first start, stores it in the workspace and prints the URL with the
token, so the editor is not open to everyone on the network.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: generates a random connection token on first start (stored in `workspace/.connection-token`) and passes it with `--connection-token-file`; the URL with `?tkn=…` is printed in the container log.

zh-cn.descript: OpenVSCode Server 把 VS Code 跑在 NAS 上：在任何设备用浏览器编辑文件、开终端、用 git、装扩展，工作区持久化在应用数据目录。本包额外生成了一个随机连接令牌，不知道打印出来的 URL 就无法打开编辑器。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。首次启动会生成连接令牌，并在容器日志（docker logs openvscodedocker）里打印完整地址（http://<NAS-IP>:<端口>/?tkn=...）；令牌同时保存在 DockerAppData/openvscodedocker/workspace/.connection-token。内置终端以 uid 1000 操作你的 NAS——请只在内网使用，暴露到公网前务必配置带 TLS 的反向代理。卸载并删除数据前请先备份 workspace 目录。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 OpenVSCode Server 1.105.1，以非 root 容器运行。浏览器 IDE，支持终端、git 与扩展；随机连接令牌，工作区持久化在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: OpenVSCode Server 把 VS Code 跑在 NAS 上：在任何裝置用瀏覽器編輯檔案、開終端、用 git、裝擴充功能，工作區持久化在應用資料目錄。本包額外產生了一個隨機連線令牌，不知道印出來的 URL 就無法開啟編輯器。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。首次啟動會產生連線令牌，並在容器日誌（docker logs openvscodedocker）裡印出完整位址（http://<NAS-IP>:<端口>/?tkn=...）；令牌同時保存在 DockerAppData/openvscodedocker/workspace/.connection-token。內建終端以 uid 1000 操作你的 NAS——請只在內網使用，公開到互聯網前務必配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份 workspace 目錄。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 OpenVSCode Server 1.105.1，以非 root 容器運行。瀏覽器 IDE，支援終端、git 與擴充功能；隨機連線令牌，工作區持久化在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/home/workspace` (mounted from `DockerAppData/openvscodedocker/workspace`) holds your projects, the `.openvscode-server` extensions/settings and `.connection-token`.
design_notes: **Token instead of open access.** The upstream container disables the connection token; the wrapper generates one and stores it in the workspace, so the editor is protected by a random URL.
**Runs as uid 1000.** The image's `openvscode-server` user matches the TOS application user.
limitations: - The token is printed in the log and stored in the workspace; delete the file and restart to rotate it.
- The terminal runs as uid 1000 on the NAS; treat access like SSH access.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy for remote access.
